Method of Attack: directory traversal attack via automated macro execution triggered by mouseover event in maliciously crafted ODT document
Impacted Systems: all LibreOffice releases up to and including 6.0.6/6.1.2.1
Attack Vector: malicious ODT document with pre-installed macros executed on mouse-over event
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-Concept FODT extension uploaded to VirusTotal
